name: libdeepmd

raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "deepmd-kit" %}
{% set version = "3.2.0" %}
{% set lammps_version = "stable_22Jul2025_update5" %}
{% set lammps_date = datetime.datetime.strptime(lammps_version.split('_')[1], "%d%b%Y") %}
{% set lammps_conda_version = "{:%Y.%m.%d}".format(lammps_date) %}
{% set proc_type = "cuda" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu" %}
{% if mpi != 'nompi' %}
{% set mpi_prefix = "mpi_" + mpi %}
{% else %}
{% set mpi_prefix = "nompi" %}
{% endif %}

package:
  # Build the native package at the top level, then split the Python install
  # into an abi3 output.  This keeps dp_ipi out of the Python-version-
  # independent package while compiling the source tree only once.
  name: libdeepmd
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/deepmodeling/{{ name }}/archive/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 37a86e487c9d4fd3dff497cbbb3cdecc346b01a3381dc65545ffe5182aa5e030
    patches:
      - patches/0001-find-external-protobuf-for-tensorflow-2.21.patch
      - patches/0002-support-lammps-2025-kokkos-api.patch
      - patches/0004-register-lammps-kokkos-plugin-styles.patch
      - patches/0005-share-lammps-kokkos-runtime.patch
  - url: https://github.com/lammps/lammps/archive/{{ lammps_version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 9d1eb62c47b8bb1c2003dfe5b5e82b3ebef4223b51593f9aec2410c5ec983977
    folder: lammps
    patches:
      - patches/0003-kokkos-build-cuda-fatbins.patch

build:
  number: 6
  # Kokkos calls the CUDA driver API directly.  The real libcuda is supplied
  # by the host NVIDIA driver rather than by a conda runtime package.
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - "*/libcuda.so.1"  # [linux and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
  string: cuda{{ cuda_compiler_version | replace('.', '') }}h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ mpi_prefix }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
  string: cpu_h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ mpi_prefix }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}  # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
  run_exports:
    # Consumers compile against the C++ API; constrain them to the current
    # minor series because DeePMD-kit does not promise a stable C++ ABI.
    - {{ pin_subpackage("libdeepmd", max_pin="x.x") }}
  skip: true  # [win]
  skip: true  # [cuda_compiler_version in ("11.8",)]
  skip: true  # [py==313]
  skip: true  # [aarch64 and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
  skip: true  # [aarch64]
  skip: true  # [osx and x86_64]
  # All outputs are produced by the python_min build.  deepmd-kit's wheel is
  # tagged abi3 upstream, so later CPython versions reuse this one build.
  skip: true  # [is_abi3 and not is_python_min]
  ignore_run_exports_from:
    # These Python packages are needed to compile the abi3 output, but the
    # native libdeepmd output links their C++ runtime subpackages instead.
    - python
    - tensorflow
    - pytorch

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - {{ compiler('cuda') }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - cmake >=3.23
    - make  # [unix]
    - ninja
    - python                                 # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - cross-python_{{ target_platform }}     # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - {{ mpi }}  # [build_platform != target_platform and mpi == "openmpi"]

  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - scikit-build-core
    - hatch-fancy-pypi-readme
    - tensorflow
    - tensorflow * {{ proc_type }}*
    - libtensorflow_cc
    - libtensorflow_cc * {{ proc_type }}*
    - pytorch
    - pytorch * {{ proc_type }}*
    - libtorch
    - libtorch * {{ proc_type }}*
    - setuptools_scm
    - {{ mpi }}
    # Keep all CUDA toolkit dependencies aligned with the selected compiler.
    - cuda-cudart-dev  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    # Kokkos' exported CMake package resolves the CUDA driver target while
    # compiling the GPU-resident LAMMPS plugin.
    - cuda-driver-dev  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    # CMake's CUDA compiler identification resolves cicc through the target
    # prefix; provide the nvvm target symlink in the host environment as well
    # as the compiler's build environment.
    - cuda-nvvm-dev_{{ target_platform }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    # The CUDA compiler identification source includes this header, which is
    # shipped by the target-specific NVCC development package.
    - cuda-nvcc-dev_{{ target_platform }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - cuda-version {{ cuda_compiler_version }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    # require by pytorch
    - libcublas-dev    # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - libcurand-dev  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - libcufft-dev     # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - cuda-nvrtc-dev   # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - cuda-nvtx-dev    # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - libcusparse-dev  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - libcusolver-dev  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - libcudss-dev     # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - dependency-groups
    - libabseil
    - tomli

  run:
    - libtensorflow_cc
    - libtensorflow_cc * {{ proc_type }}*
    - libtorch
    - libtorch * {{ proc_type }}*
    - {{ mpi }}

  run_constrained:
    # The Kokkos plugin shares LAMMPS' ABI; constrain the matching processor
    # variant so a CPU/GPU mismatch cannot be solved at runtime.
    - lammps {{ lammps_conda_version }} cuda{{ cuda_compiler_version | replace('.', '') }}*_{{ mpi_prefix }}_*  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
    - lammps {{ lammps_conda_version }} cpu_*_{{ mpi_prefix }}_*  # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]

test:
  commands:
    - test -x "${PREFIX}/bin/dp_ipi"
    - test -f "${PREFIX}/include/deepmd/DeepPot.h"
    - test -d "${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/DeePMD"
    - dp_ipi

outputs:
  - name: libdeepmd
    files:
      include:
        - '**'
      exclude:
        # The Python files and console scripts belong exclusively to the
        # python_version_independent deepmd-kit output below.
        - lib/python*/site-packages/deepmd/*
        - lib/python*/site-packages/deepmd/**/*
        - lib/python*/site-packages/dpa_adapt/*
        - lib/python*/site-packages/dpa_adapt/**/*
        - lib/python*/site-packages/deepmd_kit-*.dist-info/*
        - lib/python*/site-packages/deepmd_kit-*.dist-info/**/*
        - bin/dp
        - bin/dpa-adapt
        - bin/dpaad

  - name: {{ name|lower }}
    build:
      python_version_independent: true  # [is_abi3]
      string: cuda{{ cuda_compiler_version | replace('.', '') }}h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ mpi_prefix }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
      string: cpu_h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ mpi_prefix }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}  # [cuda_compiler_version == "None"]
      # Avoid running the cross-compiled host interpreter just to create pyc
      # files; conda regenerates them for the interpreter in the target env.
      skip_compile_pyc:
        - "*.py"
    files:
      include:
        - lib/python*/site-packages/deepmd/*
        - lib/python*/site-packages/deepmd/**/*
        - lib/python*/site-packages/dpa_adapt/*
        - lib/python*/site-packages/dpa_adapt/**/*
        - lib/python*/site-packages/deepmd_kit-*.dist-info/*
        - lib/python*/site-packages/deepmd_kit-*.dist-info/**/*
        - bin/dp
        - bin/dpa-adapt
        - bin/dpaad
    requirements:
      host:
        - python
        - python-abi3  # [is_abi3]
        - tensorflow
        - tensorflow * {{ proc_type }}*
        - pytorch
        - pytorch * {{ proc_type }}*
        - {{ mpi }}
      run:
        - python >={{ python_min }}
        - tensorflow
        - tensorflow * {{ proc_type }}*
        - pytorch
        - pytorch * {{ proc_type }}*
        - numpy >=1.21
        - scipy
        - dargs >=0.4.7
        - pyyaml
        - {{ mpi }}
        - h5py
        - wcmatch
        - packaging
        - ml_dtypes
        - mendeleev
        - array-api-compat
        - python-vesin
        - e3nn
        - python-lmdb
        - msgpack-python
        - einops
        - nvalchemi-toolkit-ops
        - {{ pin_subpackage("libdeepmd", exact=True) }}
    test:
      files:
        - water_se_a.json
        - water.lmp
        - in.lammps
      source_files:
        - examples/water/data
      imports:
        - deepmd
        - deepmd.tf
        - deepmd.pt
      requires:
        - abi3audit  # [is_abi3]
        - pip
        # Match the LAMMPS processor variant used to build the plugin.
        - cuda-driver-dev  # [linux and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - lammps {{ lammps_conda_version }} cuda{{ cuda_compiler_version | replace('.', '') }}*_{{ mpi_prefix }}_*  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - lammps {{ lammps_conda_version }} cpu_*_{{ mpi_prefix }}_*  # [cuda_compiler_version == "None" and not aarch64]
        # nvalchemi-toolkit-ops, used by the PyTorch backend, supports Python
        # 3.11+ only.  Keep the MPICH test on the oldest solvable interpreter;
        # abi3audit below still verifies compatibility with python_min (3.10).
        - python 3.11  # [mpi == "mpich"]
        - python 3.12  # [mpi == "openmpi"]
      commands:
        # The bundled extension modules must remain independent of a specific
        # CPython ABI when the output is marked python_version_independent.
        - abi3audit "${SP_DIR}"/deepmd/lib/*.so -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 {{ python_min }}  # [is_abi3]
        - pip check
        - dp -h
        - dp train -h
        - dp freeze -h
        - dp test -h
        - dp_ipi
        - mv examples/water/data/data_0 ./data
        - dp train water_se_a.json
        - dp freeze -o frozen_model.pb
        - export OMPI_MCA_plm=isolated OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=yes OMPI_MCA_plm_ssh_agent=false  # [mpi == "openmpi"]
        # GitHub's CUDA runners do not expose the NVIDIA driver library.  The
        # development stub exercises plugin loading without requiring hardware.
        - export LD_PRELOAD="$PREFIX/lib/stubs/libcuda.so"  # [linux and cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - printf 'plugin list\ninfo styles pair\n' | lmp_mpi -log none -echo none -in /dev/stdin > lammps-pair-styles.txt  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - grep -q "deepmd/kk" lammps-pair-styles.txt  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - grep -q "dpa4spin/kk" lammps-pair-styles.txt  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - grep -q "pair style plugin deepmd/kk/device" lammps-pair-styles.txt  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - grep -q "pair style plugin deepmd/kk/host" lammps-pair-styles.txt  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - grep -q "pair style plugin dpa4spin/kk/device" lammps-pair-styles.txt  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - grep -q "pair style plugin dpa4spin/kk/host" lammps-pair-styles.txt  # [cuda_compiler_version != "None"]
        - mpiexec -n 1 lmp_mpi -in in.lammps  # [not aarch64]
